levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن مت الجوهري

notes: the first route ends at محمد بن أحمد with no saying: it meets the second route at that name (the «many routes meet at one name» convention) and the saying is carried by the second and third routes; the text writes the names again in each route, so the tail is not shared

«قال قلت لأبي عبد الله (ع)» has the Imam as the one asked and answering: imam_in_text, the last link (owner ruling 2); the third route's «وَ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ» says the same saying through another chain, so it is a route, not a variant
«أبي» in the third route is the compiler's father, unnamed: relation; the occurrence counts are by the word «أبي» in the text, and the surface is taken from the text as written
